scope: Default-off off/auto/on sparse mmap advice with page-aligned deduplicated adjacent-merged WILLNEED ranges

amdahl.W_C_O_s: not assigned from the instrumented route smoke
amdahl.mechanism: auto selects random advice when useful row bytes are less than half the page-aligned prefetch bytes; every gather deduplicates touched pages and merges adjacent pages before WILLNEED
amdahl.overlap_exclusions: telemetry and advice route wall is excluded from performance evidence and cannot be combined with PLE gather/dequant/H2D or complete-wall buckets
amdahl.strict_fallback: off is the default and preserves the prior path

decision: Close the mechanism prerequisite only. The real mmap route selects random advice and emits merged page-aligned WILLNEED ranges with canonical output.
